newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Solana and NATO ambassadors to visit Sarajevo.
newsitem.headline: Solana and NATO ambassadors to visit Sarajevo.

text.p: NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana and the sixteen ambassadors to the alliance's Brussels headquarters will visit Sarajevo on Friday to meet Bosnian leaders and senior figures in the international community.

NATO said in a statement on Thursday the ambassadors would also be joined by the alliance's Supreme Allied Commander in Europe (SACEUR) General George Joulwan and the chairman of the military committee General Klaus Naumann.

While in the Bosnian capital the ambassadors will hold a meeting of the North Atlantic Council (NAC), the alliance's policy-making body, and meet with the commanders of the alliance-led peacekeeping force.
